issue: Loop bound is off by one: `attempt < maxAttempts` performs only maxAttempts - 1 attempts, so the parameter name does not match behaviour.
suggestion: Use `for (var attempt = 1; attempt <= maxAttempts; attempt++)` so exactly maxAttempts attempts are made.

issue: New public type RetryPolicy has no XML documentation comment.
The doc comment claims the method returns null on failure, but the implementation throws InvalidOperationException, so the comment is misleading.
suggestion: Update the comment (ideally to XML doc) to state that it throws InvalidOperationException after all attempts are exhausted.

issue: New public method Execute<T> has no XML documentation for its type parameter, parameters, return value, or thrown exception.
CA1822: Member 'Execute' does not access instance data and can be marked as static

CA1062: In externally visible method 'T RetryPolicy.Execute<T>(Func<T> operation, int maxAttempts)', validate parameter 'operation' is non-null before using it. If appropriate, throw an 'ArgumentNullException' when the argument is 'null'.
CA1031: Modify 'Execute' to catch a more specific allowed exception type, or rethrow the exception
Empty catch block silently discards every exception, leaving no way to diagnose why retries failed.
suggestion: Capture the exception (`catch (Exception ex) when ...`), record it, and pass it as the inner exception of the final InvalidOperationException.
